first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The dark blue-black long gun in the lower-right foreground of the first-person view, with a box-shaped body, a wide flat top cover, and light-colored edge lines.

entities.name: layered rock wall
entities.identification: The greenish-brown high rock walls enclosing the narrow passage, with horizontally undulating bands, mottled textures, and polygonal angled corners.

entities.name: gray-green passage floor
entities.identification: The gray-green low-texture ground between the layered rock walls, with varying width, faceted surfaces, and transverse step-like edges.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The only separate person revealed from behind the rock corner on the left, with short black hair and a relatively light-colored face, wearing a dark blue-black top, long pants, and black boot-like shoes.
